note: Every requirement traces to a promise made in the release notes. 'source' names the section. Nothing here is invented: if the notes do not promise it, it is not a requirement.

requirements.verify: Integration test: suspend/approve/resume cycle recorded
requirements.evidence: packages/collect-oma/src/journal.mjs (SplitstickApprovalStore); suspend/approve/resume test against OMA DurableApprovalLedger

requirements.verify: E2E test against a reference MCP server over stdio

requirements.title: MCP proxy collector (HTTP)
requirements.statement: Same capture over HTTP transport.
requirements.source: Getting started — tested against MCP servers over stdio and HTTP
requirements.verify: E2E test against a reference MCP server over HTTP

requirements.title: Digest tool identity and arguments
requirements.statement: Record and digest the tool name and its invocation arguments.
requirements.verify: Red-team attack A fails closed
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/collector.mjs; red-team A1 DETECTED (LEAF_MISMATCH)

requirements.title: Digest tool result
requirements.statement: Record and digest the tool result content.
requirements.verify: Red-team attack A fails closed
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/collector.mjs; red-team A3 DETECTED; result-shape tests for string, parts and non-text content

requirements.title: Digest approval decisions
requirements.statement: Record and digest approval decisions, including the deciding identity as supplied.
requirements.verify: Unit test: decision tamper detected
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/collector.mjs approval path; packages/collect-oma/test/journal.test.mjs approval tests

requirements.title: Predecessor chaining
requirements.statement: Every event carries a cryptographic digest of its predecessor.
requirements.verify: Red-team attacks B, C, F fail closed
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/chain.mjs; packages/core/test/chain.test.mjs; red-team B, C, E, F DETECTED

requirements.title: Per-leaf salting
requirements.statement: Every leaf is salted with a per-leaf random nonce before hashing.
requirements.verify: Unit test: identical content yields distinct digests
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/leaf.mjs; packages/core/test/leaf.test.mjs (distinct digests for identical content)

requirements.title: Batch signing with operator key
requirements.statement: Sign each batch root with the operator-supplied key.
requirements.source: Integrity — batches are signed with your key
requirements.verify: Signature verifies under operator public key
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/note.mjs + signer.mjs; Collector.checkpoint; note signature verifies under the operator vkey

requirements.title: Forward-secure epoch ratchet
requirements.statement: Evolve the signing key per epoch and destroy the predecessor so prior entries cannot be re-signed with the current key.
requirements.verify: Test: epoch N key cannot produce a valid epoch N-1 signature; the succession chain walks from a pinned root across 64 epochs, and a skipped epoch, a wrong-predecessor endorsement, a self-endorsement, a fork and an unpinned root are each refused
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/succession.mjs (0x04 endorsement subject binding key AND epoch number, verifySuccession, successionReport); Collector.rotate endorses through the signer seam then journals, and the epoch is read off disk on open so a restart cannot fork it; Store.appendEpoch/readSuccessionDetailed with the newline as commit marker; the verifier attributes each checkpoint to an epoch by note key id, so ONE pinned root verifies every epoch. Tests: packages/core/test/succession.test.mjs (rows 12-17 of docs/m2-failure-modes.md), packages/core/test/ratchet.test.mjs, packages/verify/test/succession.test.mjs

requirements.title: C2SP checkpoint emission
requirements.statement: Emit checkpoints in C2SP tlog-witness conformant format.
requirements.verify: Checkpoint is a C2SP note inside a DES-20 envelope; packages/core/test/c2sp-conformance.test.mjs asserts the wire format against the spec as written
requirements.evidence: Store writes <n>.json envelopes via buildEnvelope; the note is the signed subject and countersignatures sit beside it

requirements.title: Configurable witness set
requirements.statement: Submit roots to a configurable list of witnesses rather than a single endpoint.
requirements.verify: witnessesFromConfig builds the set from config.witnesses; an unknown type is refused rather than skipped
requirements.evidence: packages/witnesses/src/index.mjs + test; a misspelled type that silently anchored to nothing would leave an operator believing they were anchored

requirements.title: Rekor witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support Rekor as a witness type.
requirements.verify: Rekor adapter with fetch injected; declares existence and NOT sequence, and refuses a public instance on the per-batch tier (FR-47)
requirements.evidence: packages/witness-rekor; the signed note line is searched for rather than read from a fixed path, because Rekor's shape varies by version and entry type

requirements.title: transparency-dev/witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support transparency-dev/witness as a witness type.
requirements.verify: Anchor against a local instance

requirements.title: RFC 3161 TSA adapter
requirements.statement: Support an RFC 3161 timestamp authority as a witness type.
requirements.verify: Verified against a GENUINE LibreSSL-produced TimeStampToken committed as a fixture; the signer must carry extendedKeyUsage=id-kp-timeStamping as its sole purpose (RFC 3161 2.3), and the chain must reach an anchor the reader supplied through certificate authorities only
requirements.evidence: Verification in packages/core/src/rfc3161.mjs with a strict hand-written DER reader (no ASN.1 dependency in the verifier's closure) over the shared trust path; submission in packages/witness-tsa

requirements.title: Operator-hosted witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support an operator's own internal witness endpoint.
requirements.verify: Operator-hosted stateful witness: enrolment, consistency-proof sequence enforcement, retained roots, signed tree heads, key history. The critical state transition is held under an exclusive CROSS-PROCESS lock covering enrolment, and is crash-consistent: recovery reconciles the retained history with the active state before validating anything
requirements.evidence: packages/witness-self; the promise chain alone let two processes retain two distinct roots at one height (6/6 with a barrier), and a crash between the root append and the state write let a conflicting successor in afterwards. Tests race two real processes and SIGKILL one mid-transition

requirements.title: Splitstick hosted witness adapter
requirements.statement: Support the Splitstick hosted witness.
requirements.verify: Hosted witness round trip

requirements.title: Configurable quorum
requirements.statement: Accept a K-of-N quorum setting governing how many countersignatures a batch requires.
requirements.verify: Quorum counted PER CAPABILITY CLASS and reported as three numbers, never one
requirements.evidence: Anchorer and verifyWitnesses; two time-only witnesses buy redundancy of time, not independence of sequence

requirements.title: Configurable anchor cadence
requirements.statement: Accept an anchor_interval setting that determines the mutability window.
requirements.source: Independence — cadence is yours to set
requirements.verify: anchor_interval default asserted at 10s; the anchor tier submits at that cadence
requirements.evidence: Anchorer.anchor + config DEFAULTS; packages/core/test/rollup.test.mjs asserts the default

requirements.title: Soft anchor tier
requirements.statement: Provide a fast anchor tier, default every 10 seconds.
requirements.verify: Soft tier runs at anchor cadence; the rollup tier is not asked on every checkpoint
requirements.evidence: Anchorer tier filtering, asserted in packages/core/test/anchor.test.mjs

requirements.title: Hard anchor tier
requirements.statement: Provide an optional slow, trust-minimised anchor tier that no company can withdraw.
requirements.verify: OpenTimestamps proof parsing with the operations APPLIED, not merely collected; reported as a commitment to a block, never as confirmed
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/opentimestamps.mjs + packages/witness-ots; pending is pending, not failure; a proof over other bytes is refuted while a mangled one is only broken

requirements.title: Policy changes as chain events
requirements.statement: Record any change to the witness set or quorum as a timestamped event inside the chain.
requirements.verify: Red-team: policy downgrade is visible in the record

requirements.title: Signed heartbeats
requirements.statement: Emit signed heartbeats into the collector-scoped chain at a configured interval, independently of whether any run is active, because the dangerous window is precisely when none is.
requirements.verify: Stopping the collector produces a detectable gap, including during an interval with no agent run

requirements.title: Build digest in heartbeat
requirements.statement: Each heartbeat carries the collector build digest, binding a run to a traceable artifact for configuration assurance and non-repudiation by an honest operator. It is not an attestation of the running process and does not detect a dishonest patch.
requirements.verify: Digest present and resolvable to a published provenance attestation; test asserts no claim of patch detection appears in output

requirements.title: Gap declarations with an exact span
requirements.statement: When the observation counter survived the failure, record a signed declaration naming the exact source_seq span that was observed but never written. It occupies one record position. Observation gaps are detected from consecutive persisted source_seq values, never by comparing source_seq with record_seq, which count different things.
requirements.verify: A gap occupies exactly one record position whatever its span; a reversed, zero-bounded or non-integer span is refused and consumes no position
requirements.evidence: Collector.gap + record.mjs validation; packages/core/test/gaps.test.mjs asserts gaps are read from consecutive persisted source_seq and never by comparing counters

requirements.title: Countersigned gap declarations
requirements.statement: Gap declarations are themselves submitted for countersignature.
requirements.source: Coverage attestation — signed, countersigned statement of absence
requirements.verify: The declaration falls under a countersigned checkpoint, which is what establishes WHEN it was declared; the fail-open case where it falls after the last anchor is asserted separately
requirements.evidence: packages/core/test/gaps.test.mjs; a gap whose time is self-asserted can be backdated to cover whatever the operator needs covered

requirements.title: splitstick coverage
requirements.statement: Produce a coverage report over a date range stating the proportion of actions the collector reported that were captured, chained and anchored, plus heartbeat continuity — never a claim about actions the collector did not report. Attempts and logical actions are counted separately, since one action may span several attempts.
requirements.verify: Report wording asserted by test; injected gaps appear exactly; attempt and logical-action counts are both present and differ under retry; a suppressed action does not appear and the report does not imply completeness

requirements.title: splitstick verify
requirements.statement: Verify chain integrity, batch signatures and witness countersignatures from files alone.
requirements.verify: All red-team classes fail closed; baseline passes
requirements.evidence: packages/verify/src/verify.mjs + cli.mjs; packages/verify/test/verify.test.mjs; redteam/splitstick.mjs

requirements.title: Acceptance policy as input
requirements.statement: The verifier takes a caller-supplied acceptance policy naming trusted witness keys and quorum.
requirements.source: Proof — an input, not a hardcoded trust store
requirements.verify: The same pack verified under two acceptance policies gives two different, internally consistent answers; an empty policy says the reader trusted nobody
requirements.evidence: verifyStore opts.policy; packages/verify/test/witness.test.mjs rows 27-31

requirements.title: Evidence pack carries all countersignatures
requirements.statement: Packs include every countersignature collected, not only Splitstick's.
requirements.verify: Every countersignature is carried in the envelope with an explicit `covers`, and the type-to-subject pairing is enforced rather than documented
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/envelope.mjs; a c2sp-note entry must cover the note and a token entry the digest

requirements.title: splitstick disclose
requirements.statement: Emit a Merkle inclusion proof for a single named event.
requirements.verify: Recipient verifies one event without the rest

requirements.title: Inclusion proof binds to countersigned root
requirements.statement: Inclusion proofs verify against a countersigned root, not a bare local digest.
requirements.verify: Proof rejected when root is unwitnessed

requirements.title: Optional batch padding
requirements.statement: Provide optional padding of batches with dummy leaves to obscure activity volume. Padding is applied only at batch close and never retroactively; dummy leaves are explicitly typed so a verifier holding the pack can count them; and a real action can never be reclassified as padding, because its leaf is already committed.
requirements.verify: Retroactive padding is rejected; a verifier reports real and dummy leaf counts separately; reclassifying a committed action fails the leaf check

requirements.title: Payloads are content-addressed and externalised
requirements.statement: No payload enters the chain. Every argument and result is replaced by a salted content digest, cid = H(0x05 || content_salt || plaintext), and the plaintext is stored encrypted in the deletable store. Substituting a payload while preserving its pointer is therefore impossible, and deleting the salt, key and ciphertext leaves an unlinkable commitment.
requirements.source: Erasure — no content is ever in the chain
requirements.verify: Payload-substitution test: replacing stored content without changing the cid fails verification. Automated scan asserts no payload bytes appear anywhere in the chain
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/content.mjs (cid over the plaintext); red-team A2 DETECTED (CONTENT_MISMATCH); chain scanned for payload bytes

requirements.title: Crypto-shredding
requirements.statement: Deleting content and its key leaves the chain verifiable and the commitment permanently unlinkable.
requirements.verify: Verify passes after content+key deletion

requirements.title: Retention policy on storage
requirements.statement: Retention and erasure are configurable at the storage layer, independent of the cryptography.
requirements.source: Erasure — policy settings on your storage
requirements.verify: Retention config honoured; chain unaffected

requirements.title: Fail-open with marked batch
requirements.statement: When no witness is reachable, chain and sign locally, mark the batch unwitnessed, and queue it.
requirements.verify: Agent completes with all witnesses unreachable

requirements.title: Late countersignature records real time
requirements.statement: A retroactive countersignature records the witness's actual receipt time, not the batch's claimed time.
requirements.verify: Test asserts the witness receipt time differs from the batch timestamp and both appear in the record

requirements.title: Late anchors reported as gaps
requirements.statement: Windows anchored late are reported as coverage gaps.
requirements.source: Operations — reported as a coverage gap
requirements.verify: Coverage report flags the widened window

requirements.title: Configuration file
requirements.statement: Support splitstick.yaml with store, signer, anchor_interval, rollup_interval, heartbeat_interval, on_unavailable, witnesses, quorum and unwitnessed_ceiling keys.
requirements.verify: The documented example config is loaded in test and each key asserted to take effect; heartbeat_interval is present because it sets the resolution of every coverage claim
requirements.evidence: packages/core/src/config.mjs; packages/core/test/config.test.mjs loads design/default-config.yaml and asserts each key

requirements.title: Operator enrolment
requirements.statement: Operator identity is the operator public key together with the log origin, and it is the same notion whether the witness is hosted or self-hosted. Only the provisioning differs: with a self-hosted witness it is local configuration and no account exists anywhere, which is what the zero-egress promise means; with a hosted witness it is a registration.
requirements.source: Witness Practice Statement — this enrolled operator
requirements.verify: Enrolment required before any submission; re-enrolling under a different key refused because it would reset the sequence state
requirements.evidence: StatefulWitness.enrol; without an identity the witness cannot know whose successor a submission is

requirements.title: Witness verifies consistency, not increments
requirements.statement: The witness accepts a checkpoint whose tree_size is greater than or equal to the last it recorded for that operator AND whose Merkle consistency proof from the previous size verifies. It does not require tree_size to increase by one: a checkpoint published every 10 seconds or 1,024 records legitimately jumps. Witness state is updated atomically with the signature.
requirements.verify: Sequence enforced by RFC 6962 consistency proof, not by successor: sizes legitimately jump, and a forked tree fails the proof at any size. Enforced under an exclusive cross-process lock, so two witness processes cannot each accept a different successor
requirements.evidence: StatefulWitness.addCheckpoint — 400 on regression, 409 on fork or unverifiable proof, 503 on contention, idempotent on retry; Anchorer computes the proof over the tree the checkpoint COMMITS TO; packages/witness-self/test/concurrency.test.mjs races two real processes

requirements.title: Witness retains roots
requirements.statement: The witness keeps submitted roots in its own append-only store.
requirements.source: Witness Practice Statement — has retained it
requirements.verify: Every root retained in order and never overwritten, asserted across three submissions. Crash-consistent: the newline is the commit marker so a torn tail is dropped rather than parsed, damage in the middle refuses to start, and a root retained without the state having advanced is reconciled on load and inside the critical section rather than ignored
requirements.evidence: StatefulWitness #readRoots/#reconcile + roots.jsonl; two different roots at one height fails CLOSED, because a witness that cannot tell which it accepted would rest every later signature on a guess. packages/witness-self/test/crash-consistency.test.mjs

requirements.title: Witness stamps its own clock
requirements.statement: The countersignature carries the witness's own time, not the operator's.
requirements.source: Witness Practice Statement — at this time, per its clock
requirements.verify: The witness records its own received_at, and an RFC 3161 token's genTime is the TSA's clock; neither is the operator's
requirements.evidence: StatefulWitness state + rfc3161 genTime surfaced in the verifier's witness entries

requirements.title: Conformance test suite
requirements.statement: Publish an executable conformance suite any witness implementation can run against itself.
requirements.source: Licence and governance — conformance suite is open
requirements.verify: Suite runs green against the reference witness

requirements.title: Witness list as data
requirements.statement: Maintain the list of known conformant witnesses as a machine-readable file, each entry carrying its acceptable-use terms, rate limits, and whether it retains entries publicly, so an operator chooses on informed grounds rather than by default.
requirements.source: Licence and governance — a plain file in the repository
requirements.verify: File parses; the collector consumes it; every entry states its acceptable-use position
